name: Construct a new explanatory framework
short_description: Construct and stress-test a novel framework that reconciles at least three mature bodies of evidence.
self_assessment: I can construct one framework across three evidence bodies without help and survive five documented counterexample tests.
description: Construct and stress-test a novel framework that reconciles at least three mature bodies of evidence. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Build and challenge a framework spanning three literatures
